# windowsddi_dns_conditional_forwarder (Resource)

Manages a conditional forwarder (`Add-DnsServerConditionalForwarderZone`, `Set-DnsServerConditionalForwarderZone`, `Remove-DnsServerZone`): queries for the domain are forwarded to `master_servers`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "windowsddi_dns_conditional_forwarder" "partner" {
  name              = "partner.example.com"
  master_servers    = ["192.0.2.53", "192.0.2.54"]
  replication_scope = "Forest"
  forwarder_timeout = 3
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `master_servers` (List of String) IPv4 or IPv6 addresses of the DNS servers to forward to, in the order they are tried. Equivalent IPv6 spellings (for example `2001:DB8::53` and `2001:db8::53`) never show a diff.
- `name` (String) Forwarded domain, for example `partner.example.com`. Casing and a trailing dot are ignored when comparing. Changing it replaces the forwarder.

### Optional

- `forwarder_timeout` (Number) Seconds to wait for a master server before trying the next one. When unset, the server default (5) is used and reported.
- `replication_scope` (String) Stores the forwarder in Active Directory and sets where it replicates: `Forest`, `Domain` or `Legacy`. When unset the forwarder is stored on this server only. Changing between the three values is done in place; setting or unsetting it replaces the forwarder.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Forwarded domain in canonical form (lowercase, no trailing dot).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by zone name.
terraform import windowsddi_dns_conditional_forwarder.partner partner.example.com
```
